name: Four sketches of figures and cattle, Macau
summary: Four studies by George Chinnery in Macau, three of them dated 21 November 1837: (LL) a small boat carrying two Chinese figures; (CL) a figure seated by a cooking stove; (UL) a Portuguese soldier standing by the shore; (R) a figure seated by a cow and calf.
